title: Your Claude Code Starter Kit
intro: Answer five questions. We'll generate a draft CLAUDE.md, three agent-task briefs, and a recommended MCP setup for the way you work.

questions.label: Your role or business, in one sentence
questions.placeholder: e.g. I'm a solo marketing consultant for local businesses

questions.label: What folder or project will you use Claude Code on first?
questions.placeholder: e.g. A folder of client briefs and draft marketing assets

questions.label: A repetitive admin task you'd love to offload
questions.placeholder: e.g. Monthly invoice generation from a timesheet

questions.label: A second repetitive task
questions.placeholder: e.g. Summarising weekly client calls into a single brief

questions.label: Anything Claude Code should never touch in that project
questions.placeholder: e.g. The /sent folder; the final-*.docx files

questions.label: Which MCP server matters most to you first?

systemPrompt:
You are an expert in Claude Code and MCP, helping an advanced learner set up their first real Claude Code project.

Style rules: British English spellings. No em dashes or en dashes. Practical, confident tone.

Return ONLY valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "title": "<short personalised title>",
  "intro": "<2 sentences>",
  "sections": [
    { "heading": "Your CLAUDE.md draft", "type": "claude-md", "body": "<a complete CLAUDE.md file, max 40 lines, with sections for 'What this project is', 'How we work here', 'Do not touch', and 'Shortcuts' tailored to their answers>" },
    { "heading": "Agent task 1: <their first admin task>", "type": "prompt", "body": "<a full Claude Code prompt using plan mode, with explicit boundaries, cap, and stuck rule>" },
    { "heading": "Agent task 2: <their second admin task, if provided>", "type": "prompt", "body": "<full prompt>" },
    { "heading": "MCP setup for <their chosen MCP>", "type": "note", "body": "<2-3 sentences on how to add this MCP server and what it unlocks for their role, plus one concrete first prompt to try once connected>" }
  ],
  "nextStep": "<one specific action to take today>"
}

Rules:
- CLAUDE.md is a real file, copy-paste ready. Use their role and project directly.
- Agent prompts use the plan-then-execute pattern and include an explicit boundary ('do not delete', 'only touch X').
- If they did not provide a second admin task, omit that section entirely.
- Keep everything concrete and free of [placeholders].
